question: Can the published Figure 6d dose-response columns pass the unchanged v6.0.0 fast-mode 29-estimator input gate?
scope: Compatibility gate only; no full target/control run and no T0/TLog/IC50 equivalence claim.
source_sheet: Figure 6, rows 95-103; 8 dose levels for Figure 6d
interpretation: The current fast gate requires 50 points, whereas each published curve has at most 8 dose levels. Therefore this source is useful to design a separately calibrated dose-response mode, but it cannot support a v6.0.0 full pipeline run as-is. Columns remain separate and are not concatenated as pseudo-replicates.
